summary: CWE-534: The bad() entry point wrote user-controlled and sensitive data (the request 'username' parameter and the server-side HttpSession ID) into a debug-level log record, exposing sensitive information to anyone with access to the log. The fix preserves the legitimate behavior (validating the username, creating the session, and emitting a debug log entry) but removes the sensitive values from the logged message so no confidential data is exposed in the log.

edits.old:
HttpSession session = request.getSession(true);
                                                              
                logger.log(Level.FINEST, "Username: " + username + " Session ID:" + session.getId());
edits.new:
HttpSession session = request.getSession(true);
                logger.log(Level.FINEST, "A user request was processed successfully.");
